base: App icon for "Manga Cleaner", a desktop app that removes Japanese text from manga speech balloons and leaves clean, empty balloons ready for translation. macOS app icon format: one rounded-square (squircle) tile centered on the canvas, the tile fills about 82% of the canvas, fully transparent background outside the tile, clean alpha edges, no backdrop, no drop shadow outside the tile. Flat front view, no perspective tilt. Clean vector-like shapes, strong silhouette, balanced negative space, one clear focal symbol that still reads at 16 px. Brand palette: warm paper off-white #F6F5F2 and deep ink black #141514, with at most one accent color. No words, no letters, no logos, no watermark, unless the concept below says otherwise.
concepts: 01-ink-bubble

Concept: a single plump, perfectly empty off-white speech balloon with a short curved tail, centered on a deep ink-black tile. Inside the tile, a very subtle manga screentone dot pattern fades from the top-left corner. Calm, confident, premium.
02-eraser-wipe

Concept: a white speech balloon where the left half still holds three vertical columns of black Japanese brush-stroke text and the right half is perfectly clean, divided by the diagonal path of a soft rose-pink (#A63B5F) rubber eraser resting on the balloon. Paper off-white tile.
03-sparkle-bubble

Concept: a pristine white speech balloon with one crisp four-point sparkle star glinting at its upper-right edge, as if freshly cleaned. Tile is a rich rose #A63B5F with a gentle vertical gradient to a slightly deeper rose.
04-halftone-cutout

Concept: the whole tile is covered in black manga halftone dots that grow larger toward the bottom; a speech balloon shape is cut out of the dots as pure off-white negative space, with no outline. Graphic, bold, print-like.
05-page-stack

Concept: a small stack of three manga pages seen straight on, slightly offset; the front page shows a simple panel with one clean empty speech balloon. Ink-black line art on off-white paper, tile in light warm grey.
06-sumi-brush-balloon

Concept: the outline of a speech balloon painted in one confident black sumi-ink brush stroke, with dry-brush texture at the end of the stroke forming the tail. Interior is empty paper. Off-white textured paper tile.
07-enso-hanko

Concept: a zen enso circle in black ink whose open end curls into a speech-balloon tail, with a small square red hanko seal stamp (#A63B5F, no legible characters, just an abstract balloon glyph carved in it) at the lower right. Off-white paper tile.
08-hanko-seal

Concept: the entire tile is a vermilion-rose (#A63B5F) traditional hanko seal stamp, with a slightly rough, inked stamp texture at the edges; a white speech balloon glyph is carved in the center as negative space. No readable characters.
09-squeegee

Concept: a small squeegee sweeping across a speech balloon, leaving a gleaming clean streak behind it while a few faint grey text marks remain ahead of it. Playful but clean flat illustration, mint accent #6FCFA2 squeegee blade, off-white tile.
10-mint-fresh
Concept: a white speech balloon with three short 'shine' tick lines at its upper-left, on a fresh mint #6FCFA2 tile with a soft top-to-bottom gradient. Friendly, fresh, clean.
11-dissolve-text

Concept: inside a white speech balloon, vertical columns of black Japanese-style brush marks dissolve upward into tiny square pixels and dots that fade away, leaving the lower balloon clean. Deep ink-black tile.
12-magic-wand

Concept: a slim black magic wand with a small white star tip touching the edge of an empty white speech balloon, a few tiny sparkles around the contact point. Deep ink tile with a very subtle radial glow behind the balloon.
13-layered-paper

Concept: layered cut-paper speech balloons stacked with real paper depth and soft shadows between layers: back layer ink black, middle layer rose #A63B5F, front layer off-white and empty. Paper craft look, off-white tile.
14-frosted-glass

Concept: a frosted translucent glass speech balloon floating over a deep ink-to-charcoal gradient tile, with soft rim light, subtle refraction of faint blurred manga lines behind it. Premium, modern macOS feel.
15-clay-3d
Concept: a soft, glossy 3D clay-like white speech balloon with gentle studio lighting and a soft contact shadow, sitting on a warm off-white tile. Rounded, tactile, friendly. Still front-facing.
16-marquee-select

Concept: an empty white speech balloon surrounded by a dashed rectangular selection marquee with small square handles at the corners, like an image editor selection. Deep ink tile, marquee in mint #6FCFA2.
17-inpaint-mask

Concept: a white speech balloon where the text area is covered by a translucent rose-red (#A63B5F) inpainting mask overlay with soft edges, half of the mask already peeled away revealing clean white. Ink-black tile. Technical, editor-like.
18-panel-grid

Concept: the tile is a manga page with a tight grid of four panels separated by white gutters; the largest panel contains one clean empty speech balloon, the other panels show minimal ink hatching. Black and off-white only.
19-nib-ready
Concept: an empty white speech balloon with a black fountain pen nib poised at its lower right, ready to letter the translation. Ink-black tile, nib has a small rose #A63B5F highlight.
20-lasso
Concept: a hand-drawn looping lasso selection line in mint #6FCFA2 wrapped around an empty white speech balloon, the line ending in a small dot. Deep ink tile.
21-pop-art-burst
Concept: a bold pop-art spiky 'shout' speech balloon, empty, with thick black outlines, on a tile filled with large rose #A63B5F Ben-Day dots on off-white. Loud, comic-book energy.
22-monoline
Concept: an ultra-minimal Swiss monoline icon: a single thin continuous black line draws a speech balloon and its tail, centered with generous negative space on an off-white tile. Elegant, quiet.
23-soap-sponge

Concept: a small rose-pink kitchen sponge in the lower-left corner releasing soap bubbles; the largest bubble is shaped like a speech balloon, iridescent and clean. Off-white tile. Witty visual pun on cleaning speech bubbles.
24-k-monogram

Concept: a bold geometric letter K (for the maker brand Komiq) formed in off-white on an ink-black tile, where the negative space between the K's arms forms a small speech balloon. This concept may show the single letter K and nothing else.
25-ink-drop

Concept: a single glossy black ink drop falls from the top of the tile; where it would land, a crisp empty white speech balloon sits, as if the ink has been lifted off the page. Off-white tile, strong figure-ground contrast.
